prompts.s3: Finale cutscene part 3 of 3, complementary color return, memory homecoming. The deep indigo (#3E55C9) starfield slowly fades and warms, hue rotating through the color wheel back to dawn: the scene settles into the first era's warm ochre-gold (#C9915C) over a quiet prehistoric steppe at first light. The camera comes to rest on the exact horizon where a lone three-tier wooden watchtower silhouette stands, mirrored composition of the game's opening. A spearhead-triangle silhouette rests planted in the earth at the frame's corner. Memory fragments drift down gently like ember snow, settling into the ground. Mist, warm horizon glow, utter stillness and closure. Static held shot with imperceptible slow breathing. Ambient sound: soft morning wind over grassland, distant birdsong, warm sustained pad fading to near silence.
